name: Conditional Antimatroids Are PC-Minor-Closed
statement: Every nonempty pc-minor of a finite conditional-antimatroid partial cube is again a conditional-antimatroid graph class.
proof: Choose a signed orientation that is intersection-closed. Projection commutes with intersection, and a nonempty coordinate section is intersection-closed. Both operations preserve ampleness. If the original root is lost, normalize the total intersection of the image family; newly constant coordinates cause no obstruction. Iterate for pc-minors.
